summary: Pure capture state machine, no I/O: score = uncaptured reads x1 + settled edits x2 + active stops; arm at T_ARM=10 requiring >=2 active stops and >=2 uncaptured files; fires descent (1 quiet stop, INJECT) or cap@20 (INJECT), and only headDrift BLOCKS. EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED 2026-07-24 by replaying this module against a real logged session: the descent path has NEVER fired in this repo's entire .coldstart/kb-hook.log history (104 stops, 22 fires = 12 head-drift + 6 cap + 4 subagent, 0 descent; armed=true appears only 4 times). Cause is that T_ARM=10 is out of range for normal session size, not a reset bug: score needs ~10 uncaptured files or ~4 files plus 3 settled edits, while the log's session sizes are bimodal - 3-6 files for focused work (peaks at score 4-6, never arms) vs 35-45 files for long/resumed sessions (blows past 20 so cap fires). Head-drift and cap therefore cover only the two extremes and the normal-session middle band is silent; one observed session ran 8 consecutive quiet stops with armed=false while DESCENT_QUIET=1 made it eligible 8 times over. Note that a fire marks every uncaptured file captured and captured read-only files score 0 forever, so merely preventing head-drift from resetting activeStops does NOT restore descent (replay-falsified).

summary: Pure capture state machine, no I/O or clock. score = uncaptured files x1 + settled edits x2 + ALL stops since the last fire; arm at T_ARM=10 requiring >=1 active stop and >=1 uncaptured file (MIN_FILES_ARM); fires descent (1 quiet stop, INJECT), cap@20 (INJECT), or headDrift (BLOCK) - the last two keep the >=2-file MIN_FILES floor. CORRECTION 2026-07-24: this note previously blamed T_ARM=10 being 'out of range for normal session size'. That diagnosis was WRONG and is retracted. The real cause of descent never firing (104 stops / 24 fires / 0 descent) was a regression - the score's stop term read activeStops, and once synthesis turns were reclassified as quiet they no longer incremented it, so a discussion session had NO score-growth term at all and froze at ~4. T_ARM=10 is reachable and unchanged. Two other tempting fixes are also replay-falsified: stopping head-drift from resetting activeStops (still 0 descent fires), and lowering T_ARM.
